## Freemium Trial Gateway (5 Free Calls/Day per IP -> Auto HTTP 402)
- Send header `X-MCP-Trial: 1` (without `X-PAYMENT` / `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`) to receive **5 free calls/day per IP** across the 5 freemium-eligible endpoints below (`mcp-audit`, `pr-critic`, `quant-overfit-score`, `stealth-extract`, `price-extract`).
- Free responses include headers `X-Free-Tier: 1`, `X-Free-Remaining`, `X-Free-Limit: 5` and a `freemium` metadata block in the JSON body.
- Starting on call #6/day (or whenever `X-MCP-Trial: 1` is omitted), the gateway automatically returns HTTP `402 Payment Required` with a base64 `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` Solana Mainnet USDC challenge (`trial_exhausted: true` when free quota is used).
- Run directly as a Cursor / Claude Desktop Stdio MCP Server via `npx -y github:thongtuehuu-cyber/mcp-guard-kit` (exposes `audit_mcp_response`, `critic_git_diff`, `score_quant_overfit`, and `stealth_extract_url`; automatically sends `X-MCP-Trial: 1` and supports `payment_signature` or `MCP_GUARD_X402_PAYMENT` for paid x402 calls).

## Heavy-Compute x402 Verification Services
- `POST /api/x402/audit-diff` — **$0.25 USDC** — Dual-Brain AST Anti-Cheat & Security Diff Auditor: Audits git diffs for deleted/weakened assertions, pytest.skip cheats, secret leaks, and GitHub Actions script injections; returns SHA-256 attestation.
- `POST /api/x402/quant-overfit-check` — **$1.00 USDC** — 4-Gate Quant Overfit Verifier (Bar Permutation + DSR): Runs Walk-Forward OOS, Parameter Plateau, Timothy Masters Re-Optimized Bar Permutation, Deflated Sharpe Ratio, and 2x Cost Stress on a trading strategy.
- `POST /api/x402/stealth-extract` — **$0.05 USDC** — SSRF-Safe Structured Content & JSON-LD Extractor: Extracts clean structured title, metadata, JSON-LD entities, and normalized text from HTML or SSRF-checked public HTTPS URLs.
